question: Does knowledge of the threefold make one the supreme guru?
premises: A person may know the threefold.
Discerning knowledge of this threefold is the criterion.
Such a knower is considered the supreme guru.
inference: Knowing the threefold qualifies a person to be considered the supreme guru.
uncertainties: The specific contents of the threefold are not identified in this verse.
plain_english: Whoever knows the threefold is considered the supreme guru.
